docs.intro.lead.zh: KUI 是面向 GPUI 的 Rust UI 组件库，支持原生桌面与 WASM。可通过 crates.io 安装，也可复制所需组件源码。
docs.intro.lead.en: KUI is a Rust UI kit for GPUI on native desktop and WASM. Install the library from crates.io or copy selected component source.

docs.intro.what.body.zh: 共享的主题令牌、动效与 组件。crates.io 包名为 kense-kui，Rust 库名为 kui。组件库、CLI 安装源码与 Story 预览使用同一套源码。
docs.intro.what.body.en: Shared theme tokens, motion, and components. The crates.io package is kense-kui and the Rust library is kui. The library, CLI-installed source, and story previews use the same source tree.

docs.intro.org.p.zh: Primitives — 无 chrome 的行为层

docs.intro.read.4.zh: 给 AI 的说明 + Markdown

docs.install.lead.zh: 通过 crates.io 安装 kense-kui，或用 CLI 将组件源码加入项目。两种方式共用同一套组件。
docs.install.lead.en: Install kense-kui from crates.io, or use the CLI to copy component source into your project. Both paths use the same controls.

ai.lead.zh: Agent 可检索、选型并安装 KUI。crates.io 包名：kense-kui。Rust 库与 CLI：kui。许可：MIT。
ai.lead.en: Agents can search, choose, and install KUI. crates.io package: kense-kui. Rust library and CLI: kui. License: MIT.

ai.rule.1.zh: 复用 kense-kui 中的控件或复制已有 registry 项，不要另造平行控件
ai.rule.1.en: Reuse kense-kui controls or copy existing registry items instead of creating parallel controls

ai.rule.3.en: Do not enable test-support on wasm32

ai.rule.4.zh: 日常 chrome 用纯黑白；品牌色 #171717 仅用于重要时刻
ai.rule.4.en: Default chrome is pure black/white; brand #171717 only for important moments

stage.hint.zh: 实时预览 · 支持键盘

button.usage.lead.zh: 示例使用组件库的 kui:: 导入；CLI 复制源码后改为 crate::ui::。桌面与 WASM 共用控件 API，宿主启动见安装页。
button.usage.lead.en: Examples use kui:: imports from the library; use crate::ui:: for CLI-installed source. Desktop and WASM share the control API; see Installation for hosts.

docs.install.library.body.zh: 包名为 kense-kui，依赖别名与 Rust 库名为 kui，示例使用 kui:: 导入。将 gpui-pre 钉死为 =0.3.10，并在打开窗口前调用 kui::init(cx)。
docs.install.library.body.en: The package is kense-kui; its dependency alias and Rust library name are kui. Examples use kui:: imports. Pin gpui-pre to =0.3.10 and call kui::init(cx) before opening windows.

docs.install.features.body.zh: 应用依赖应关闭默认特性。默认 test-support 用于宿主冒烟测试，wasm32 禁止启用。native 提供可选平台接口；web 提供语义 HTML 控件。共享 GPUI 控件无需启用这两个特性，应用自行提供桌面或 WASM 宿主。
docs.install.features.body.en: Disable default features in application dependencies. The default test-support feature is for host smoke tests and must stay off on wasm32. native provides optional platform hooks; web exposes semantic HTML controls. Shared GPUI controls need neither feature; applications supply their native or WASM host.

docs.install.cli.body.zh: CLI 从 GitHub 安装，未发布到 crates.io。先运行 kui init，再运行 kui add <id>。复制源码后，将示例中的 kui:: 改为 crate::ui::。
docs.install.cli.body.en: The CLI is installed from GitHub and is not published to crates.io. Run kui init, then kui add <id>. For copied source, replace kui:: imports in examples with crate::ui::.
